title: Place
description: A place, with the names it went by, what it lies within and when it was there.

name.description: The name the place goes by where it is.

also-known-as.description: Every other name the place was known by.

type.description: What kind of place it is, an open word: city, parish, hamlet.

within.description: What the place lies within: a scalar, or a list with dates when jurisdictions changed.

oneOf.description: What it lies within, with dates.

coordinates.description: A latitude and a longitude in decimal degrees, north and east positive, or the record's words in parentheses.

addresses.description: Where it lies in a reckoning other than its within: a street, a parish, a county.

from.description: When the place came to be.

sources.description: What says when it began and ended, and what the record rests on as a whole.

placeName.description: A name: a bare string, or a mapping with name.

lang.description: The language the name is in, as a language tag: en, de, la.

type.description: An open word for a spelling its language does not account for: pinyin, kana.

from.description: When the place began to be called that.
